killedBy: enterGameplay: the order is the fix presses Start BEFORE waiting for the canvas that Start creates
why: Restores the ordering that made `--scene game` fail on every invocation (issue #581): waiting for the game canvas before pressing Start, when that canvas is created BY starting a session (`bootCanvas`, from session-host.ts). The real symptom was a 30-second locator timeout naming a selector rather than the missing session, which is why three separate agents diagnosed it independently and each wrote their own driver instead. Nothing tested this file before -- `run.mjs` drives a browser and had no coverage at all, which is how an always-failing code path shipped. The fake page in the scoped test models the one property that matters, that no session means no canvas, so this mutation fails there in milliseconds.
